text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is why Golshi was 
rampaging around so cheerfully since 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just got an invitation from Journey 
earlier. Said it's a welcome-back party 
for my return home.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I bet they'll beg for souvenirs and 
stories again. Whenever it's about 
overseas, both Orfe and Nakayama get 
starry-eyed like little kids.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I hear Meno's eager to run venue security. 
Heh... is that really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Since I'll be leaving the academy again 
soon, it sounds like everyone's rushing to 
get things ready.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Those two are always in total sync at 
times like this.
